== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes will only use Aura of Faith in response to attacks, regardless of the amount of damage being done. They do not use Aura of Faith in response to damage from other sources, such as spells and signets. 

== Notes ==
* This skill can only be captured from [[List of mursaat bosses|Mursaat monk bosses]].

;Game mechanics
* Unlike [[Healer's Boon]] and [[Unyielding Aura]], this skill also affects other healing sources, including [[Divine Favor]] and [[Divine Boon]]. 
** Aura of Faith increases the Divine Favor healing of itself.
* If you cast [[Spirit Bond]] first and ''then'' Aura of Faith, it will increase Spirit Bond's healing and then decrease the damage. But if you cast Aura of Faith first, it will reduce the incoming damage ''before'' Spirit Bond checks if it is over 50 (resulting in fewer heals from Spirit Bond).
